annotations.title: Order an evidence extract for observed domains

description: Create a payment link for an evidence extract: everything this archive recorded on a domain, as one verifiable document (every observed day, every file type, both witnesses, with the seals and verification instructions). One to twenty domains. A domain this archive never observed is refused by name before the link is created, because there would be nothing to deliver; use check_coverage first. This call charges nothing. After a person has paid on the returned page, a confirmation with the reference follows at once and the extract is normally delivered by e-mail within five working days. Only domains are asked for, never a purpose or a matter. Terms: https://machinewitness.eu/extract · Fees: https://machinewitness.eu/services

domains.description: Domain names, one to twenty, e.g. example.eu.

email.description: Delivery address, prefilled on the payment page. Optional; the page asks for it otherwise.

language.description: Language of the payment page and the e-mails. Default en.
